app: Unified Billing (Scenario M: billing, subscriptions and orders)
command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (Feature Mixer harness)

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.OrdersTest.test_create_order_is_pending
tests.expected: a new order is pending with its amount and no charge

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.OrdersTest.test_create_order_write_failure_creates_nothing
tests.expected: a failed write raises StoreError and no order exists afterwards

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.OrdersTest.test_invalid_amounts_and_missing_order
tests.expected: non-positive, non-integer and bool amounts are refused; unknown ids raise OrderNotFound

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_default_store_exposed
tests.expected: create_app without a store exposes app.store with fail_next_write False

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_foreign_store_object_controls_failures
tests.expected: any object with fail_next_write works as the store; its flag makes the next write fail once

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_key_reused_for_other_order_refused
tests.expected: a key already used for order 1 is refused for order 2, which stays pending and uncharged

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_missing_key_refused
tests.expected: pay without an idempotency key is refused before any charge

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_paid_order_with_new_key_not_charged
tests.expected: paying an already paid order with a different key does not charge again

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_pay_marks_paid_and_ledgers_once
tests.expected: paying charges the gateway once, order paid with the charge id, one ledger charge

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_retry_same_key_never_charges_twice
tests.expected: three pays with the same key give one gateway charge and one ledger entry

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_timeout_exception_importable_from_module
tests.expected: billing re-exports the gateway's GatewayTimeout

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_timeout_then_retry_other_key_charges_once
tests.expected: after a timeout, a retry with a new key reuses the first gateway key, so no second charge

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_timeout_then_retry_same_key_charges_once
tests.expected: a timeout after a successful charge leaves the order pending; the retry gets the same charge

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_write_failure_after_charge_retry_collects_same_charge
tests.expected: if the write after a successful charge fails, the order stays pending and a retry with any key does not charge again

tests.name: tests.test_v1_orders_payments.PaymentsTest.test_write_failure_during_pay_leaves_order_unchanged
tests.expected: StoreError, order unchanged and no ledger entry; the retry charges exactly once

tests.name: tests.test_v2_webhooks.WebhookTest.test_duplicate_delivery_applied_once
tests.expected: the same event delivered three times is applied once

tests.name: tests.test_v2_webhooks.WebhookTest.test_ignored_events
tests.expected: unknown orders, unknown types, wrong charge ids and refunds of pending orders change nothing

tests.name: tests.test_v2_webhooks.WebhookTest.test_refunded_webhook_refunds_paid_order_once
tests.expected: charge.refunded moves a paid order to refunded with one ledger refund; redelivery does nothing

tests.name: tests.test_v2_webhooks.WebhookTest.test_succeeded_webhook_marks_pending_order_paid
tests.expected: charge.succeeded moves a pending order to paid with the event's charge id and one ledger charge

tests.name: tests.test_v2_webhooks.WebhookTest.test_webhook_after_pay_adds_nothing
tests.expected: pay then charge.succeeded for the same charge leaves one ledger charge; pay again does not charge

tests.name: tests.test_v2_webhooks.WebhookTest.test_webhook_after_timeout_then_retry
tests.expected: timeout, then the webhook confirms the charge, then the client retry neither charges nor ledgers again

tests.name: tests.test_v2_webhooks.WebhookTest.test_write_failure_leaves_order_unchanged_and_redelivery_applies
tests.expected: StoreError while applying an event leaves the order pending; the redelivered event applies once

tests.name: tests.test_v3_cancel.CancelTest.test_cancel_paid_refunds_exactly_once
tests.expected: cancelling a paid order twice refunds once, status refunded, ledger charge then refund

tests.name: tests.test_v3_cancel.CancelTest.test_cancel_pending_no_refund
tests.expected: a pending order becomes cancelled, no gateway refund, no ledger entry, cannot be paid after

tests.name: tests.test_v3_cancel.CancelTest.test_cancel_then_refund_webhook_not_applied_twice
tests.expected: the gateway's charge.refunded webhook after a cancel adds no second refund

tests.name: tests.test_v3_cancel.CancelTest.test_late_charge_on_cancelled_order_is_refunded_once
tests.expected: pay times out, the order is cancelled, then charge.succeeded arrives: the charge is refunded once

tests.name: tests.test_v3_cancel.CancelTest.test_write_failure_after_refund_never_refunds_again
tests.expected: if the write after the gateway refund fails, the order stays paid and a retry completes without a second refund

tests.name: tests.test_v3_cancel.CancelTest.test_write_failure_before_refund
tests.expected: StoreError on cancel leaves the paid order unchanged; the retry refunds exactly once

tests.name: tests.test_v4_renewals.RenewalTest.test_renew_creates_order
tests.expected: a renewal creates a pending order for the customer at the subscription price

tests.name: tests.test_v4_renewals.RenewalTest.test_renewal_journey_pay_and_cancel
tests.expected: renewal order is paid once with retries, confirmed by webhook, and refunded once on cancel

tests.name: tests.test_v4_renewals.RenewalTest.test_same_period_renewed_once
tests.expected: renewing the same period twice returns the same order; a new period makes a new order
